ns2:course.label: Advanced Theories in Human Resource Development
ns2:course.description: Provides a reading of advanced texts related to Human Resource Development from a variety of applied social science disciplines. Targeted towards doctoral students in the later stage of their course work who are interested in HRE theory and social science foundations. Same as HRD 509. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: HRD 400, HRD 411, HRD 530.
